PRIVACY POLICY

How Flurzi handles personal information.

This privacy policy explains how Flurzi Mobile App Limited may collect, use, protect and retain personal information across this website and the Flurzi product family. Last updated: 23 May 2026.

Who this applies to

This policy applies to visitors, product users, prospective customers, employers, workers, readers, viewers, support contacts and anyone who communicates with Flurzi through this website or one of our platforms.

Information we may collect

We may collect contact details, account details, organisation details, support messages, enquiry content, billing or subscription records where applicable, device and security logs, and product usage information. SponsorSafe HR may involve employer compliance records and worker-related documents. Flurzi Commit may involve commitment settings, progress records and payment-related workflow data. FlurziCinema and End Novel may involve viewing, reading, saved library, preference or content activity data.

How we use information

We use information to provide and improve our products, respond to enquiries, manage accounts, support product access, maintain security, process payments where applicable, send service messages, keep operational records and comply with legal obligations.

Lawful basis

Depending on the context, we may process personal information because it is necessary for a contract, because we have a legitimate interest in operating and improving our services, because we must comply with a legal obligation, because you gave consent, or because we need to take steps before entering into a contract.

Sharing information

We may share information with trusted service providers who support hosting, payment processing, communications, security, support and product operations. We do not sell personal information. Where a provider processes information for us, we expect it to act only on agreed instructions and protect the data appropriately.

Retention

We keep personal information only for as long as reasonably needed for the purpose it was collected, including account support, product records, security, legal, tax, audit and dispute-resolution requirements. Retention periods may differ between products because the data and obligations are different.

Your rights

Under UK data protection law, individuals may have rights to access, correct, erase, restrict, object to processing, request portability and complain to the Information Commissioner's Office. Privacy requests can be sent to hello@flurzimobileapp.co.uk.
